newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Electric rate case suspended.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Electric rate case suspended.

text.p: El Paso Electric said Thursday that the New Mexico Public Utility Commission granted a motion to suspend its rate case compliance filing pending the recommendations of a newly established collaborative working group which will deal with issues pertaining to deregulation of the electric utility industry in New Mexico.
Members of the group include utilities, as well as consumer, business and environmental organizations.

The order establishing the collaborative process requires the presentation of a consensus proposal for restructuring the regulation of the electric industry in New Mexico with proposed legislation by August 1, 1997.
If consensus is not reached by August 1, 1997, or the collaborative process terminates before such date, the suspended regulatory action will resume.
